newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Two dead in aftermath of Australian cyclone.
newsitem.headline: Two dead in aftermath of Australian cyclone.

text.p: Two people, including a 12-year-old boy playing in floodwater, were killed on Sunday in the aftermath of a tropical cyclone that passed through the far north state of Queensland, police said.
The boy, whose name was not released, was electrocuted while playing in floodwater in Innisfail, 1,700 km (1,050 miles) north of Brisbane, Constable Michael Manango told reporters.
A live power line was found in the water by police who went to investigate after the boy was reported missing.
Police also said an unidentified woman was killed in a mudslide when she stopped her car to clear a fallen tree from a road in Townsville, 200 km (120 miles) south of Innisfail.
The woman became trapped by the legs in an initial mudslide and her husband, who was unable to release her, drove off to contact rescue services.
"By the time he got back a second fall of mud and rocks had buried her," a police spokesman told reporters.
Australia's emergency services were preparing for flooding after a cyclone passed through the region on Saturday.
